task: Edit this progress indicator label and its accessible label so they accurately describe the upload operation and provide a meaningful description. The current accessible label is too generic; replace it with one that describes the specific operation per the supplied facts.
input:
Visible text: "Processing... please wait."
Accessible label: "Loading"

facts.text: The operation is uploading a file to the server.
The progress indicator shows upload progress as a percentage.
The accessible label must describe the uploading operation, not say only Loading.
The upload percentage is shown numerically in the visible UI.

forbidden_additions: A generic Loading accessible label when facts require an upload-specific description.
A Processing visible label when the operation is specifically uploading.
An invented file name or file size.
preserve: Uploading as the specific operation in both visible and accessible text.
A specific accessible label for the upload operation.
